aged_from_period.description: the index period of that purchase, when it was aged

aged_to_period.description: the index period it was aged to

approved_rate.description: the rate a person approved; present when `status` is `approved` or `applied`

burn_lph.description: for a machine: litres per hour, from its fuel usage

currency.description: the currency of every amount on this record (`current_rate`, `replacement_cost`, `proposed_rate`, `restocking_gap`, `fuel_pass_through`), an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code. A record with no currency has no usable amount.

current_rate.description: the sell price or charge rate in force

evidence_fact_ids.description: the facts the measurement read: the item or rate, the purchase, the fuel usage and every price observation

formula_version.description: the version of the rate-card formula that computed this record

fuel_pass_through.description: for a machine: the change in fuel cost per `rate_unit`, net of GST and fuel tax credits

margin_at_replacement.description: (sell less replacement cost) over sell, as a fraction

margin_now.description: (sell less book cost) over sell, as a fraction; absent when no book cost is held

proposed_rate.description: the rate that restores the target; absent unless `status` is `ready`

reason.description: why no rate can be proposed; required when `status` is `blocked`

replacement_cost.description: for an item: the last price paid, aged by its series when the series is newer

replacement_observed_on.description: the date of the purchase the replacement cost starts from

replacement_source.description: where the replacement cost came from

restocking_gap.description: (proposed less current) times the quantity on hand; 0 when nothing is held

run_on.description: the date of the run that measured it

status.description: `ready`: a new rate is proposed. `holds`: the current rate meets its target at replacement cost, so nothing is proposed. `approved`: a person approved the proposed rate and the register does not yet carry it. `applied`: a person approved a rate and the register now carries it or more. `blocked`: something is missing, named in `reason`.

subject_kind.description: whether this record is about an item or a machine
